2609.16321.title: FairLint-DL: An IDE-Native Tool for Fairness Debugging of Deep Learning Software
2609.16321.paper_summary: Existing fairness analysis tools predominantly operate as post-training evaluation frameworks, requiring practitioners to complete the full model development lifecycle before assessing bias. We present FairLint-DL, a Visual Studio Code extension that implements a shift-left approach to fairness testing by enabling pre-training, IDE-native bias detection directly on tabular datasets. FairLint-DL trains a configurable deep neural network as a proxy model and applies information-theoretic Quantitative Individual Discrimination (QID) metrics. Grounded in Shannon and min-entropy, QID quantifies the causal influence of protected attributes on predictions. The system implements a two-phase gradient-guided search algorithm for discovering discriminatory instances, a causal debugging pipeline that localizes bias to specific network layers and neurons via sensitivity analysis, and dual explainability engines using SHAP and LIME for feature-level attribution. Evaluation on three tabular benchmarks (Adult Census Income, German Credit, and Bank Marketing) reveals fairness concerns that vary widely across datasets: on Adult, 96.0% of analyzed instances exhibit QID above the 0.1-bit significance threshold, with a mean QID of 0.619 bits and a disparate impact ratio of 0.581, violating the four-fifths legal rule. FairLint-DL produces these results within 12 seconds on cached models, demonstrating the feasibility of integrating fairness analysis into the developer workflow without significant overhead.
2609.16321.paper_summary_zh: 現有的公平性分析工具主要作為訓練後評估框架運作，要求從業者在評估偏見之前完成完整的模型開發生命周期。我們提出了 FairLint-DL，一個 Visual Studio Code 擴展，它通過在表格數據集上啟用訓練前的 IDE 原生偏見檢測，實現了向左轉移的公平性測試方法。FairLint-DL 訓練一個可配置的深度神經網絡作為代理模型，並應用信息論的定量個體歧視（QID）指標。基於香農和最小熵，QID 量化了受保護屬性對預測的因果影響。該系統實現了一個兩階段的梯度引導搜索算法，用於發現歧視性實例，一個因果調試管道通過敏感性分析將偏見定位到特定的網絡層和神經元，以及使用 SHAP 和 LIME 的雙解釋引擎進行特徵級歸因。在三個表格基準（成人普查收入、德國信貸和銀行行銷）的評估中，顯示出跨數據集存在的公平性問題：在成人數據集中，96.0% 的分析實例顯示 QID 超過 0.1 位的顯著性閾值，平均 QID 為 0.619 位，且不平等影響比為 0.581，違反了四分之五的法律規則。FairLint-DL 在緩存模型上在 12 秒內產生這些結果，證明了將公平性分析整合到開發者工作流程中的可行性，且不會產生重大開銷。
